texts.zh:
你们为什么还要用如此无能的扩张继续玷污星河？看来是所有人都因为太过厌恶而不愿告诉你们，所以我们来说：没人喜欢你们的边境，如果你们不在这片星域，一切都会好得多。

[offending_system.GetName]恒星系既不实用又不和谐。为了星系的团结，你们必须立即从你们的帝国中清除它。
texts.en:
Why must you continue blighting the galaxy with your incompetent expansions? Everyone must be too repulsed to tell you so we'll say it: nobody likes your borders and space would be vastly improved if you were not in it.

The [offending_system.GetName] system is impractical and discordant. You must purge it from your Empire now for the sake of galactic cohesion.

label.zh: 你们想让我们放弃一个恒星系就为了美化边境？！
label.en: You want us to abandon a system to prettify our borders?!

tooltips.zh: 我们必须解散在[offending_system.GetName]恒星系的恒星基地，否则将面临[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]的怒火。
tooltips.en: We must disband our starbase in the [offending_system.GetName] system or suffer the wrath of the [fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]

label.en: But we like it like this!

tooltips.zh: 我们必须解散在[offending_system.GetName]恒星系的恒星基地，否则将面临[fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]的怒火。
tooltips.en: We must disband our starbase in the [offending_system.GetName] system or suffer the wrath of the [fallen_empire_hive_control.GetName]

texts.zh:
装疯卖傻？你们只需要放弃[offending_system.GetName]恒星系就够了。

也许我们应该更积极地收拾你们。
texts.en:
Are you being deliberately ignorant? All you needed to do was rid yourself of the [offending_system.GetName] system.

Perhaps we should take a more active role in pruning you.
